text: Between 14:02 UTC and 14:31 UTC, the system experienced an incident that affected API requests. During this time, 12% of API requests failed with HTTP 502. This problem occurred because a new deployment removed the cache warmup step. Without the cache warmup step, the system sent traffic to cold cache instances. Engineers identified the problem and reverted the deployment at 14:27 UTC. The cache instances loaded required data after the revert. All API requests returned to normal operation at 14:31 UTC. We added a guard to make sure that future deployments include the cache warmup step.
